verdict.rationale: Slack docs confirm searchability across all shared content and unlimited message history on paid plans (slack-docs-43, slack-docs-16), which supports team-admin search of message history, but the evidence never documents specific filter operators like sender, channel, or date scoping. Community evidence also notes that on free/lower tiers older messages disappear after limits, undercutting the 'full history' claim (slack-comm-10, slack-comm-15). missing for 10: explicit documentation of sender/channel/date search filters, admin-specific search tooling, and independent confirmation that filtered search works as described.
